kept.title: Timing of winter sidewalk clearing
kept.detail: The City starts clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm, and crews typically finish a full clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours. Sidewalks may not yet be cleared for a walk in the middle of the night or early morning soon after snowfall. The report says transit stops were cleared using machines and hand crews, focused on a TTC priority list, but the data does not show whether these stops are on that list.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.
the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.

kept.title: Laneways are salted, not plowed
kept.detail: Under the Council-approved service level, public laneways are only salted, within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and are not plowed. Any walking route that uses a laneway could have snow left on it.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
